dialogue.line: My brother thinks he's a mechanical genius. He forgot half the bolts.
If we take your truck, promise me you'll change that tape.
There's a cat on your hood. Don't start it. Do NOT.
Sayyad said to watch you. You drive like a rushed farmer.
The video store closes in twenty minutes. I'm not paying late fees.
Your left signal blinks twice as fast. The bulb's dead.
Don't touch the radio. I have nails, and I will use them.
Wrong way. Shortest is not by the Galeries. Turn around.
What is that smell in here? Fries under the seat again?
Don't pull out too fast, I have a coffee.
I brought my own straps. Your yellow clothesline is embarrassing.
Cut through the bike path again and I'll tell my mother.
Not bad. You missed the ditch better than my brother does.
Here, ten bucks for gas. Buy a real air freshener.
We're in one piece. My ears are still ringing from your muffler.
Seven out of ten. Minus one for the pothole. Six.
Next time, learn to downshift without grinding the gears.
Perfect. Unload it by the wall and don't drop the box.
Seven for the driving. Three for your vinyl seats.
Thanks for the lift. If Sayyad asks, we were shopping for parts.
The corner cat likes me. Just so you know.
Unlock the tailgate before you yank on it like a savage.
We made it on time. Go show off at the dep.
Good job. With you, at least it arrives the same day.
My brother sleeps until noon, then talks until midnight.
He has a theory about everything. Everything. Ask him about toast.
He's polite with my mom and every grown-up. It's suspicious.
Don't take his driving tips. He has a theory about those too.
He explained the Mac to our mother. Twice. She nodded twice.
Honk all you want. He sleeps through everything.
Every sentence has the word Mac in it. I counted.
He says the Civic is fast. He also says Macs don't crash.

_: Zahra's get-in, get-out and about-her-brother lines, merged by story.js applyDialogue. English (Tom, 6 Oct and 20 Oct 2026); rewritten 20 Oct (S1-ENGLISH). Canon: she is 16, Sayyad's sister, loves cats, goes for you with her nails, corrects people (tic « Wrong. »).
